- Lacy signed with RCA Records in 2021 and first recorded "Bad Habit" that June, using a beat and drums he had used before. - Diana Gordon wrote part of the ending. John Carroll Kirby and Matthew Castellanos are also credited as co-writers.
- Lacy said the song was finished a week before he submitted *Gemini Rights* to RCA (Guardian, Shaad D'Souza, Dec. 22, 2022, https://www.theguardian.com/music/2022/dec/22/my-mom-thinks-im-doing-drugs-but-im-at-home-baking-cookies-steve-lacy-on-his-breakout-year).

- Brittany Fousheé, Diana Gordon, Matthew Castellanos: songwriting

- Released June 29, 2022, by RCA Records as the second single from *Gemini Rights*, which came out July 15, 2022.

- The song went viral on TikTok starting in July 2022 and was used in over 710,000 videos by January 2023.
- Fan-made sped-up versions spread widely, one of which appeared in over 430,000 videos. RCA then released an official sped-up version. Lacy initially found the idea "gross" but agreed, hoping it would help the song reach No. 1 on the Hot 100 (Guardian, as above).

- Debuted on the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 100 in July 2022, Lacy's first chart entry.
- Reached No. 1 on the Hot 100 in October 2022, ending "As It Was" by Harry Styles's 15-week run.
